terms.comment: River crab and sea crab alike; also the sign of the zodiac and, in medicine, a spreading sore (see cancer). Cato has the plural cancerēs.

phrases.latin: cancrī in pavōre et retrōrsī parī vēlōcitāte redeunt
phrases.english: when frightened, crabs run backwards just as fast

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 298.
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-plinius), checked against the editions named there.
